title: Extended Cyber Kill Chain for AI-Era Threats
description: A defender-side extension of the Lockheed Martin Cyber Kill Chain for LLM and agentic AI threats. Adds a model supply chain compromise pre-attack stage (Stage 0), AI-specific sub-techniques across the original seven stages, and a split of Actions on Objectives into classical data exfiltration, model extraction, and agentic pivot. Version 1.1 adds sub-techniques for agent memory poisoning, agent-to-agent protocol abuse, agent credential and token theft, and computer-use agent attacks; refreshes the MITRE ATLAS mapping to v2026.10; adds a mapping to the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications (2026); publishes the framework as JSON and a STIX 2.1 bundle; and includes four 2026 case studies and example Sigma rules tagged with EKC IDs.
